# rProject

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan 2026-10-14

## Description

A collection of functions to setup R (R Core Team, 2026) projects. This
package is intended for personal use only.

## Installation

You can install the released version of `rProject` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject) with:

\
`if`` ``(``!`[`require`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`"pak"`](https://pak.r-lib.org/)`)``)`` `[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"pak"``)`\
`pak``::`[`pkg_install`](https://pak.r-lib.org/reference/pkg_install.html)`(``"ijapesigan/rProject"``)`

## More Information

See [GitHub Pages](https://ijapesigan.github.io/rProject) for package
documentation.

See [Quarto Pub](https://ijapesigan.quarto.pub/rproject) for package
wiki and other resources.

## References

R Core Team. (2026). *R: A language and environment for statistical
computing*. R Foundation for Statistical Computing.
<https://www.R-project.org/>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AI()`](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject/reference/AI.md) :
  Write the Project's AI Instructions

- [`AIGlobal()`](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject/reference/AIGlobal.md)
  : Install Global AI Instructions

- [`Bib()`](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject/reference/Bib.md) :
  Consolidate .bib Files into a Single File

- [`BibLib()`](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject/reference/BibLib.md)
  : Copy .bib Files from lib-\* GitHUb Repositories

- [`Binary()`](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject/reference/Binary.md)
  : Setup Binaries not Included in the Package

- [`Build()`](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject/reference/Build.md)

  Build `.Rbuildignore`

- [`CFF()`](https://github.com/ijapesigan/rProject/reference/CFF.md) :

  Build `CITATION.cff`
